name: [unnamed] New Store, La Salle street
trade: dry goods, groceries, hardware, crockery, boots, shoes and hats, wholesale and retail

locations.basis: The paper names a street and no house on it.
locations.limit_reason: The paper names La Salle Street and nothing narrower; the anchor "Hubbard & Co.'s brick store" names nothing the committed town holds.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1835-08-12, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: This record names nobody the resident layer holds a card for, so there is no person to read a community off. The silence is in the register.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
